title: INTACT: Inducing Latent Reasoning on a Frozen Backbone
abstract: arXiv:2610.19568v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Latent reasoning replaces natural-language chains of thought with compact continuous "soft-token" representations, reducing the number of intermediate tokens that must be decoded autoregressively. We use a small external encoder to induce latent reasoning in a frozen backbone model. The encoder iteratively maps the backbone's hidden states to new latent blocks, constructing a latent reasoning prefix, after which the frozen model writes its remaining reasoning and its answer as text. Our method, INTACT, trains this encoder through distillation to reproduce the effect of written reasoning steps while keeping the model's behavior close to that of the frozen backbone, and then reinforces it on answer correctness. Across four frozen backbones from 1B to 8B, INTACT improves both GSM8K and average out-of-domain accuracy, including GSM8K gains from 75.8% to 79.3% on Llama-3.2-3B and from 77.6% to 79.7% on Qwen2.5-3B. translated_title: INTACT：在冻结骨干模型上诱导潜在推理
translated_abstract: 潜在推理用紧凑的连续“软词元”表示取代自然语言的思维链，减少了必须自回归解码的中间词元数量。我们使用一个小型外部编码器在冻结的骨干模型中诱导潜在推理。该编码器迭代地将骨干模型的隐藏状态映射为新的潜在块，构建一个潜在推理前缀，之后冻结的模型以文本形式写出其余的推理过程和答案。我们的方法 INTACT 通过蒸馏训练该编码器，使其再现书面推理步骤的效果，同时保持模型行为接近冻结的骨干模型，然后再根据答案正确性对其进行强化学习。在从 1B 到 8B 的四个冻结骨干模型上，INTACT 同时提升了 GSM8K 和平均域外准确率，包括在 Llama-3.2-3B 上 GSM8K 从 75.8% 提升至 79.3%，在 Qwen2.5-3B 上从 77.6% 提升至 79.7%。它还降低了端到端（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: INTACT 通过小型外部编码器结合蒸馏与强化学习，在完全冻结的大模型上诱导潜在推理，在不改变模型行为的前提下显著提升数学推理准确率并减少自回归解码开销。
en_tdlr: INTACT induces latent reasoning on frozen backbone models via a small external encoder trained with distillation and answer-correctness reinforcement, improving math reasoning accuracy while preserving the backbone's behavior and reducing autoregressive decoding overhead.
